title: Feed-A-Crowd Chickpea and Veg Salad:
subtitle: Same Meal Price, Double the Portions!
description: There's more to go around with our new Feed A Crowd recipes. With more hearty ingredients, like filling carbs and extra veggies, these larger recipes make double the portions of your current meal plan. If you're currently on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep veggies: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Cut the capsicums into 3cm chunks. Cut the zucchini into thirds widthwise, then cut into thick wedges. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

Roast veggies: Put the capsicum, zucchini, chickpeas, half the garlic, 2 tsp Italian seasoning and 1 tbs olive oil in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Put on the lined tray, reserving the bowl. Roast for 25 mins or until tender.

Make dressing: Meanwhile, put the yoghurt, 1½ tsp red wine vinegar and 1½ tsp honey in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Put the remaining garlic, remaining Italian seasoning and 1 tbs olive oil in a separate bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Halve the olives.

Toast herb bread: Transfer the roasted veggie mixture to the reserved bowl. Reduce the oven to 180C. Halve the baguettes lengthwise (see Feed A Crowd) and brush the cut sides with the garlic oil mixture. Put on the oven tray, cut side up, and bake for 8 mins or until lightly toasted.
Serve up: Divide the roasted veggie mixture among plates, scatter over the olives and drizzle with the yoghurt dressing. Serve with the herb bread and enjoy!
Feed A Crowd: Up the crunch factor and cut the baguettes into 2cm cubes instead. Toss in the garlic oil and bake until golden and crisp. Scatter over just before serving.
